name: Roshan Packages Ltd
address: 325 G-III, M.A Johar Town, Lahore (corrugated plant off Sundar Raiwind Road; flexible plant at Sundar Industrial Estate, Raiwind)
evidence: Listed corrugated plus flexible packaging maker: RSC/HSC/die-cut boxes, 2/3/5-ply board in B/C/E flute, up to 5-colour print. A sourcing directory lists Haier among its notable clients. PSX investor material and a credit report say its corrugated output serves home appliances, fruit/vegetables, food and other sectors. No TV or fridge carton line is named on its own site.
export_evidence: none found (the group has a separate fruit processing and export arm)

name: Tetra Pak Pakistan
address: Sundar Industrial Estate, Plot No. 701-704, Gate No. 02, Raiwind Road, Lahore-55150 (Lahore office: 316 Upper Mall, Lahore)
evidence: Aseptic packaging material factory opened in 2011 for about EUR 92m: Tetra Brik Aseptic, Tetra Fino Aseptic and Tetra Classic Aseptic. Over 10 billion packs a year across 29 packaging products; WCM and ISO 9001 certified.
export_evidence: Tetra Pak says 22% of 6.4 billion packages produced in one year went to customers in 21 countries; at opening it supplied Egypt and Yemen. Note it sells packaging material only to filling customers, not as a trade item.

name: UBC Convertec
address: 4-Km, Kamahan Road, Off Ferozepur Road, Adjacent State Life Housing Society, Lahore
evidence: In-house corrugated, die-cut and gluing since 1987; claims ISO 9001. Sells ventilated cartons with a moisture-resistant coating for mango and kinnow, plus printed boxes for electronics, mobile phones and appliances, and 5-ply cartons for appliances.
export_evidence: Says its cartons are built for agricultural export and export freight; no destinations named

name: Packaging Solutions (Treet group)
legal_name: Packaging Solution, a project of First Treet Manufacturing Modaraba
address: Plant: 22 KM Ferozpur Road, Kacha Tiba Rohi Nala, Lahore; Office: 72-B Industrial Area Kot Lakhpat, Lahore 54770
evidence: Corrugated boxes, containers and fibre boxes. Treet's page lists clients PepsiCo, Nestle, Shan, Engro Foods and Bake Parlor, which suggests dairy and beverage shipper cases. These are corrugated secondary cases, not liquid-contact cartons.

name: Century Paper & Board Mills
legal_name: Century Paper & Board Mills Limited (Lakson Group, PSX: CEPB)
address: Mill: 62-KM Lahore-Upper Chenab Canal Bank Road, District Kasur; HO: Lakson Square Building No. 2, Sarwar Shaheed Road, Karachi 74200
evidence: Integrated pulp and paperboard mill: coated and uncoated board, MF and MG papers, and corrugated cartons. A 2026 Profit article names it and Bulleh Shah as Pakistan's only makers of one-side coated bleached board. Cup stock and liquid packaging board are not confirmed.

name: Mirpurkhas Sugar Mills - Paper & Board Division (MSM)
legal_name: Mirpurkhas Sugar Mills Limited (Ghulam Faruque Group)
address: Factory: Sugar Mill Jamrao, Umerkot Road, Mirpurkhas, Sindh; HO: Modern Motors House, Beaumont Road, Karachi-75530
evidence: Containerboard mill (kraft liner, test liner, white test liner, fluting, 90-200 gsm) with 90,000 t/yr installed capacity. Says its liners serve corrugated packaging for fruit exports. This is a board source, not a box maker.
export_evidence: Says its products target domestic and export markets; no countries named

name: Khatri Packages
address: Plot# 952/A, Street#4, Toor Baba Road, Shershah, Karachi
evidence: Corrugated box maker that says it has operated since 1977: mango and date boxes, pizza boxes, telescopic and slotted cartons, multicolour printed cartons, corrugated rolls. Client logos include Crown Lifan, Junaid Jamshed and Mothercare.
export_evidence: Only a customer testimonial about using its cartons to export leather gloves to Canada and Japan

name: Roshan Packages (Proprietorship)
legal_name: Roshan Packages (Proprietorship), not the listed Roshan Packages Ltd
address: Sonan Lane 1, Gajju Matah, Lahore 54600 (manufacturing unit on Ferozepur Road)
evidence: Its site lists 3, 5 and 7-ply boxes in B/C/E flute, RSC, die-cut mailers, sheets, and ventilated mango and citrus boxes. No named clients.
export_evidence: Mentions export-standard cartons only; no markets named

name: MSM Packages
evidence: Self-published brochure: corrugated and folding cartons in Multan since 2014, about 500k-800k export-quality cartons a month. Multan is the mango belt, but no fruit carton is confirmed. Its website returned 403.
export_evidence: Claims export-quality cartons; no direct exports shown

name: Packworld
address: Plot No. 107, Sector 27, Korangi Industrial Area, Karachi
evidence: Corrugated RSC, trays, pizza boxes, printed and die-cut cartons, PDQ displays; about 10 million boxes a year; FSC chain-of-custody certified.

name: Falcon Packages
address: Near Khiali Bypass, Sheikhupura Road, Opp. Yashwa Marriage Hall, Muhammad Nagar, Gujranwala 52250
evidence: Automated corrugated plant: shipping cartons, printed stock boxes, die-cut boxes, dividers, shelf-ready packaging. Clients named include Adidas, Forward Sports, Jojo, Toyo Plastic and NRTC. Lists electronics among sectors served.
export_evidence: none found (its clients export sports goods)

name: Dayamer Packages
address: ST/13, Block 2, Hansa Compound Building No. 21-A, F.B. Industrial Area, Azizabad, Karachi
evidence: Custom corrugated cartons with in-house development, printing and transport for FMCG, pharma, oil and food. ISO 9001:2015 and SEDEX SMETA 4-Pillar.

name: M Seven Cartons
address: 3-KM Nishat Avenue, Rohi Nala, Gajju Mata, off 22-KM Ferozepur Road, Lahore
evidence: Corrugated boxes, die-cut boxes and sheets; directory says founded 2002 with 51-100 staff. Clients include Nishat Mills, US Apparels, Artistic Milliners and Stylers.
export_evidence: none found (indirect: supplies export cartons for textile exporters)

name: Jahangir Packages
evidence: Paperboard, stiffeners and corrugated cartons in single to triple wall: RSC/HSC, telescope, die-cut, bulk cartons, trays. Offers design, printing and QA testing.
export_evidence: none found (the wider Jahangir Group does import and export trading)

name: CustomPack.pk
address: Basement #1, Guardee Trust Building, Thornton Road, Lahore
evidence: Custom printed single and double-wall paper cups, lids, 2- and 4-cup carry trays, paper bowls and takeaway bags; MOQ 500. Mentions 'our Lahore factory'; it may be partly a print broker.
export_evidence: Has an 'Export & International Orders' link with no details
